Sales Copilot helps account teams capture meeting notes, keep account memory fresh, and turn follow-up actions into tracked work.

The workflow is deterministic and storage-backed, so the same inputs always produce the same outputs.

Deployment options include private deployment for security-sensitive teams, plus standard shared deployment for lighter use cases.

Security teams often ask about SSO, audit logging, and how customer data is isolated.

CRM sync writes account stage changes, meeting summaries, and next-step notes back through the storage layer.

This keeps the sales record consistent without needing model calls.
